# Pull Request

## Description

Provide a brief summary of the changes made in this Pull Request.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] Hardening / Security improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] New feature / Subcommand enhancement

## Testing & Verification

- [ ] Syntax checked with `bash -n anon-vm`
- [ ] Linted with `shellcheck anon-vm`
- [ ] Documentation linted with `markdownlint`
- [ ] Tested on Debian 12 / 13 VM
